answer: Acoustic-thermal gating suppresses Sybil attacks by anchoring agent identities to sealed canisters embedded in shale. Nodes prove presence by pulsing a heating element, recording the cavity's acoustic echo, and waiting until it cools to an ember before signing. Adversaries face the verifiable cost of drilling isolated boreholes and deploying dedicated transducers per persona. Unmapped rock fissures can scatter acoustic reflections, causing sporadic attestation failures for honest peers.
